title: Thanks to social media, canned sardines are a scarcity on the supermarket shelf
summary: This article explores how social media trends, particularly on TikTok, have driven an unexpected surge in canned sardine demand, creating shortages in supermarkets worldwide. The viral 'sardine girl' phenomenon and healthy eating influencers promoted sardines as a nutritious, sustainable food, overwhelming traditional supply chains that cannot quickly scale up fish catches.
problem_solved: Explains why canned sardines became unexpectedly scarce on supermarket shelves due to viral social media trends.
why_valuable: Provides fascinating insight into how social media can rapidly disrupt traditional supply chains and create artificial scarcity for everyday products.
